# End of the World Atlas

> An independent cartographic project documenting Chilean Patagonia, Tierra del Fuego, Cape Horn and Chilean Antarctica through atlas places, southern route dossiers and a lighthouse archive.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Editorial gateway and overview of the Chilean austral frontier.
- [Atlas](/atlas): Interactive atlas of southern places, signals and threshold geographies.
- [Places](/places): Documentary index of ports, channels, capes, islands and southern corridors.
- [Routes](/routes): Editorial route dossiers focused on maritime corridors, channels, beacons and threshold geography.
- [Lighthouses](/lighthouses): Archive of southern sentinels, including Cabo de Hornos, Les Eclaireurs, Evangelistas and others.
- [About](/about): The project, the team and the editorial mission.
